series: Community posts, every 2-3 days, 15 Nov - 30 Dec 2026
notes: Scheduled in YouTube Studio > Create > Create post (the API cannot create posts). Images are rendered by studio/render_cards.py into production/community/. KJV scripture only. Never #nsppd or #elroi. YouTube limits: text polls max 4 options; new channels hit a daily post limit (~6/day) until 'advanced features' verification.

posts.text: Help us choose! 🎶 Which song should get the first official LYRIC VIDEO?

image.verse: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.
image.label: Thankful Tuesday

posts.text:
Thanksgiving is the gate into God's presence. 🙌

Tell us ONE thing you're thankful for today 👇 Let's fill this page with praise.

#JesusWorldwide #Thanksgiving #GatesOfPraise
📖 Bible Quiz! Jesus healed ten lepers. How many came back to say thank you?
posts.explanation: Only one, a Samaritan, turned back to glorify God and give thanks (Luke 17:15-17). Let's be the one who comes back! 🙏

posts.text:
Sunday praise! 💃🏾🥁 Turn this up and dance for the King: "How Great You Are".

Comment one word that describes how great God has been to you this week 👇
We're designing our Daily Bread videos 🎨 Which look blesses you most?

Happy Thanksgiving to everyone celebrating 🇺🇸, and a thankful heart to all our family in Ghana, Nigeria, Kenya, Uganda, South Africa, the UK, Australia and beyond 🌍

"O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever." (Psalm 136:1, KJV)

Whatever this year has held, His mercy has not run out. Drop a 🙏 if you're grateful today, and tell us where you're watching from!

image.verse: I wait for the LORD, my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope.
image.label: Advent begins

posts.text:
Advent begins today 🕯️ The season of waiting and hoping for Jesus.

What are you waiting on God for this season? We'll pray over every comment. 👇

#Advent #JesusWorldwide
🌍 We are Jesus WORLDWIDE! Where are you watching from?
📖 Christmas Bible Quiz! Which prophet named Bethlehem as the birthplace of the coming Ruler, about 700 years early?
posts.explanation: Micah 5:2: "But thou, Bethlehem Ephratah… out of thee shall he come forth unto me that is to be ruler in Israel." God keeps His word! ✨

posts.text:
Start your week inside His gates 🙌 "Gates of Praise": a song of thanksgiving from Ghana to the nations.

Original or Contemporary version? Tell us which one you love 👇

image.verse: Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, God with us.
image.label: Emmanuel

posts.text:
Emmanuel: God WITH us. 💛 Not far away. Not distant. With you in the traffic, the office, the hospital, the market.

Type "God is with me" if you believe it today 👇
We're planning 2027 🙏 What should Jesus Worldwide make more of?
📖 Quiz time! What does the name "Bethlehem" mean?
posts.explanation: Bethlehem means "House of Bread", and that's where Jesus, the Bread of Life (John 6:35), was born. 🍞✨

posts.text: Which promise do you need to hold onto this week? Pick one and claim it 🙏

image.verse: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you.
image.title: Peace

image.verse: Fear thou not; for I am with thee.
image.title: Strength

image.verse: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing.
image.title: Hope

posts.text:
🙏 Prayer wall: Christmas travel season

Many of us are on the road this week, visiting home, family and church. Lord, keep every traveller safe, every road clear and every home full of Your peace.

"The LORD shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore." (Psalm 121:8, KJV)

Share your prayer request below and we'll pray with you. 💛

Need a quiet moment with God before Christmas? 🕯️ Spend five minutes in His presence with "Mysteries of Praise".

Where are you listening from tonight?
📖 Christmas Quiz! Who were the FIRST people the angel told about Jesus' birth?
posts.explanation: Shepherds keeping watch over their flock by night (Luke 2:8-11). God brought the good news to ordinary workers first. That good news is for YOU too! 🐑✨

image.verse: Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people.
image.label: Merry Christmas

posts.text:
MERRY CHRISTMAS from Jesus Worldwide! 🎄✨

Good tidings of great joy for ALL people: every nation, every tongue, every heart. A Saviour is born!

Drop a 🎄 and tell us how you're celebrating today, wherever you are in the world 🌍
Looking back on 2026 🙏 How did God show up for you most this year?

image.verse: Hitherto hath the LORD helped us.
image.label: Watch Night

posts.text:
Ebenezer: thus far the LORD has helped us! 🙌

Tomorrow night is Watch Night. Wherever you cross into 2027, in church, at home or on the road, cross over with thanksgiving.

Type ONE word for what you're believing God for in 2027 👇 #WatchNight #JesusWorldwide
